label: Bright Data
description: Search engines, run scrapers, and manage dataset snapshots

operations.name: search_serp
operations.description: Run a search engine request using your SERP zone. Usage is billed by Bright Data.

operations.name: get_serp_response
operations.description: Fetch the result of an asynchronous SERP request.

operations.name: list_datasets
operations.description: List the datasets available from Bright Data.

operations.name: list_dataset_snapshots
operations.description: List dataset snapshot metadata, optionally filtered by dataset or view.

operations.name: get_dataset_snapshot
operations.description: Get a dataset snapshot’s metadata.

operations.name: list_dataset_snapshot_parts
operations.description: Count dataset download parts using the same format and batch size as the download.

operations.name: list_dataset_views
operations.description: List the account’s saved dataset views.

operations.name: list_scrapers
operations.description: List scrapers configured on the connected account, with their input schemas.

operations.name: trigger_scrape
operations.description: Start a scraper job and return its snapshot ID. Bright Data bills the collection; this operation does not wait for completion.

operations.name: get_scrape_progress
operations.description: Check whether a scraper snapshot is starting, running, ready, failed or canceled.

operations.name: download_scrape_snapshot
operations.description: Download collected records as JSON data or an NDJSON/CSV file. Use a ready snapshot; large snapshots can be downloaded in parts.

operations.name: list_scrape_snapshots
operations.description: List one page of scraper snapshots. Increase skip by limit to retrieve the next page.

operations.name: get_scrape_log
operations.description: Retrieve the collection logs for a scraper snapshot.

operations.name: list_scrape_snapshot_parts
operations.description: Count the download parts for a scraper snapshot.

operations.name: get_scrape_input
operations.description: Download the original scraper inputs as a CSV file.

operations.name: pause_scrape
operations.description: Pause a running collection.

operations.name: resume_scrape
operations.description: Resume a paused collection.

operations.name: cancel_scrape
operations.description: Cancel a running collection.

operations.name: rerun_scrape
operations.description: Rerun a previous collection using its stored inputs. Bright Data bills the new collection.

operations.name: get_delivery_status
operations.description: Check a delivery job’s status and delivered files.
